title: Global projections of river flood risk in a warmer world

idea.research_question: What associations can be identified between precipitation or climate forcing and river-flood simulations?
idea.hypothesis: The associated data components contain a joint spatial or temporal signal that is not represented by a single component alone.
idea.mechanism: Align the required components, construct comparable features, estimate associations and compare against single-component baselines.
idea.analytical_approach: Multisource spatial or temporal association analysis with robustness and ablation checks
data_sources: External: climate-model precipitation and temperature forcing
idea.expected_contribution: A reproducible benchmark for association discovery across two core data components.
idea.falsification_condition: Reject if either required component is absent or not jointly represented.
